nodes.label: Floppy Disk Icon
nodes.description: A Win95-style floppy disk SVG icon (800x800px, 1024 viewBox) sourced from SVG Repo. The icon features a yellow-green (#B8CA43) floppy disk body with a dark outline, a cream/off-white (#F8F4BC) label area on the upper portion, a darker olive-green (#7E8D69) lower storage section, and a yellow-green write-protect notch cutout (#B8CA43). Horizontal lines in the lower section represent data lines. Used as a UI icon in GooseOS, a Win95-style desktop environment.
